subject: FinMetrics latency spike after model v3.2 rollout — request for provisional SLA relief
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@finmetrics.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finmetrics.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Latency regression in search after v3.2 deploy — urgent

David / Lauren,

We rolled traffic to Redwood model-v3.2 at 03:45 PT this morning for our search endpoint (long prompt paths). Within 30 minutes we started seeing p95 climb from ~220ms to ~780ms and a ~3x increase in tail latency across several shards. Attached is a small sample (latency_snapshot_20260925.csv) and our incident dashboard link.

This is impacting our core product (search latency SLO 250ms p95). We need immediate mitigation and to understand whether you can authorize a temporary SLA relief or credits while you investigate — procurement is cc'd. Please advise next steps and whether you can pin us back to the previous model variant immediately.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform Engineering
FinMetrics
From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finmetrics.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency regression in search after v3.2 deploy — urgent

Elena — thanks for the heads up and the snapshot. I'm escalating immediately.

Initial ask: please confirm the client-side average prompt length and whether you observed an increase in long-sequence traffic (>= 2048 tokens) after 03:45. That will help us triage fast.

Internal note to the team: @karthik @ben please take lead on root cause and mitigation. Possible immediate mitigations to propose to FinMetrics:
- Pin FinMetrics traffic to model-v3.1-opt (compatible variant) for up to 7 days while we diagnose;
- If rollback is needed, do a staged canary (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with a traffic split in the dedicated pool;
- Enable KV/prefix caching and short-circuit repeated prompt prefixes for the next 2 hours to drop tail latency;
- If pinning is accepted, we will request a provisional SLA exception covering the window where p95 may exceed contract SLOs.

Elena, if you approve pinning to v3.1-opt I will get procurement/finance text for credit discussion and loop legal if needed.

-David
D. Kim
Director, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency regression in search after v3.2 deploy — urgent

Quick technical readout from an initial profile (attaching model_profile_20260925.txt):
- Symptoms: increased transformer attention kernel latency for sequences with repeated long prefixes — appears correlated with the optimized fused-attention path introduced in v3.2 for improved throughput on avg sequences.
- Hypothesis: v3.2's attention tiling/striping yields worse memory/launch overhead on long-sequence hot paths used by FinMetrics' customer prompts, causing tail amplification at p95/p99.
- Risk: rolling back globally without canary risks regressions in throughput for other customers who benefit from v3.2 improvements.

Recommended mitigation plan (short horizon):
1) Immediate: pin FinMetrics routing to model-v3.1-opt in their tenant routing table (this is a config change, low-risk).
2) Short-term: enable aggressive prefix KV caching for 3 hours and reduce batch window to favor latency (30ms target).
3) If pin accepted, perform a canary rollback for 10% of other traffic to validate no cross-tenant impact before wider rollback for FinMetrics.

Estimated time to pin traffic: ~12 minutes after approval. Time to full pin + cache warm: ~45–60 minutes.

I will standby to run the change.
-Karthik
Principal Inference Engineer
From: Elena Ruiz <elena@finmetrics.com>
To: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finmetrics.com
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Latency regression in search after v3.2 deploy — urgent

Thanks David/Karthik — we approve pinning to v3.1-opt and the prefix caching change. Please proceed immediately.

Procurement note: our contract (Master Services Agreement #FM-2024-07) requires remediation and credits if SLA breaches occur; we want a provisional credit estimate for the window until p95 stabilizes and an assurance you'll notify us when the window ends. Please keep procurement cc'd for any formal credit proposals and share the DocuSign/PO link for records.

Elena
From: david_kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@finmetrics.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Actioned: traffic pinned and provisional SLA window — summary and next steps

Folks — summary of actions and status:
- 2026-09-25 11:15 PT: FinMetrics routing pin applied -> model-v3.1-opt (tenant config change).
- 2026-09-25 11:35 PT: KV/prefix caching enabled for FinMetrics; observed p95 drop to ~240ms within 20 minutes.
- 2026-09-25 12:05 PT: Monitoring alarms evaluated; p95 stabilized below 300ms but we will keep the provisional window open until 2026-10-02 23:59 PT to ensure no recurring tail bursts while we finalize root cause.

Authorizations:
- I authorize a provisional SLA exception for FinMetrics covering 2026-09-25 11:15 PT -> 2026-10-02 23:59 PT while we investigate and complete a controlled variant rollback if required.
- @Ben: please log the operational change and link INF-2241 in the incident record. @Karthik: continue the model profile and submit a final RCA by 2026-09-29.
- @Lauren: please coordinate the credit estimate with Procurement and legal; use deal FM-3482 for reference.

Attachments included here: rollback_runbook_v3.1.pdf (runbook for safe pin/rollback), model_profile_20260925.txt, latency_snapshot_20260925.csv.

Related links: https://jira.redwood.com/browse/INF-2241 (incident), https://hubspot.redwood.com/deal/FM-3482 (account).

I'll follow up with a short incident note for our execs once Karthik posts the RCA.

-David
Director, Customer Engineering
Redwood Inference
